description.html: The artificial plant on a rock is a light green, bushy plant whose branches spread out from a dark rock-shaped base. The base looks like part of the decor, so you do not need to hide it in the substrate.

An artificial plant does not wilt, needs no lighting or fertilizer and does not affect water parameters, so it is a good choice for beginners and for aquariums with fish that nibble or uproot live plants. It gives smaller fish, fry and shrimp cover and a place to rest.

It looks good in the front and middle of the aquarium, next to roots and real stones. The branches spread sideways, so leave a little space around the plant so it can be seen in full. During regular maintenance, take the plant out and rinse it with lukewarm water, removing algae with a soft brush and no detergents. Rinse it before putting it in the aquarium for the first time as well. Browse our other decorations and equipment.
